    return {

    V_u = Q(1650)          # unlevered asset value, USD million
    D_old = Q(125)         # existing debt (no tax-shield value)
    N0 = Q(90)             # original shares, million
    B_plan = Q(550)        # planned new debt
    fee_rate = Q("0.01")
    ts_rate = Q("0.30")
    cap = Q("0.35")

    def equity_post(B):
        # post-repurchase equity = Vu + tax shield - fee - total debt
        return V_u + ts_rate * B - fee_rate * B - (D_old + B)

    # Covenant check on planned issue
    if (D_old + B_plan) / equity_post(B_plan) > cap:
        # (D_old + B) = cap * (Vu - D_old + (ts - fee - 1) B), solve linearly for B
        B = (cap * (V_u - D_old) - D_old) / (1 - cap * (ts_rate - fee_rate - 1))
    else:
        B = B_plan

    net_proceeds = B * (1 - fee_rate)
    # equity just after issue, cash still held
    equity_pre = V_u + ts_rate * B - fee_rate * B + net_proceeds - (D_old + B)
    price = equity_pre / N0  # USD per share (million USD / million shares)
    shares_bought = net_proceeds / price
    shares_after = N0 - shares_bought
    equity_after = equity_post(B)

    return {
        "final": shares_after,
        "debt_issued": B,
        "repurchase_price": price,
        "equity_after": equity_after,
    }
